name: obsidian-notes
description: Reads, writes and maintains markdown so it works as an Obsidian vault and still renders on GitHub and in VS Code: a lint for broken and ambiguous links, orphans, duplicate basenames, missing index files and bad frontmatter; an index (map of content) writer; a wikilink-to-relative-markdown-link converter; one command to set a folder up as a vault; and the official Obsidian CLI when it is enabled. Evergreen: the skill re-researches Obsidian, its CLI and the agent integrations around it on a schedule and carries the evals that prove it works.
